notes: 🧾 Retired markets, honest portfolio. If a practice account still holds a share from a market the app no longer loads, its row menu used to offer “Switch to that exchange now” — a button that quietly did nothing since the picker went ASX-only. It now tells the truth instead: the market is retired, the record stays in your history, prices no longer update, nothing to press. Plus one orphaned styling rule for the old NYSE badge removed.
